paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.69% on average, with Euro Stoxx 50 strongest (+2.23%) and Nasdaq weakest (-1.48%). Brent crude changed -0.87% to 88.59. Gold changed -2.94% to 3,544.2. Bitcoin changed -2.74% to 59,533.2188. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.904%, a relative move of -0.28%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (-4.39%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-3.98%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: SpaceX-Tesla: the directors negotiating the biggest merger ever (FT Home). Five executives are charged with combining Elon Musk’s sprawling enterprises into a potential $3.5tn colossus Deals and capital markets: Nscale says it has option to stay private as tech sell-off threatens $35bn IPO (FT Markets). Chief executive Josh Payne seeks to reassure staff at the UK data centre group after cutting back on hiring Central banks and macro: Argentina expected to suffer technical recession in blow to Milei (FT World). President’s crusade against inflation weighs down economy as he prepares to mount re-election bid next year Central banks and macro: Top Fed official probed over whether she breached ‘blackout period’ (FT World). Michelle Bowman spoke at an invitation-only Bank of America dinner just hours after a central bank meeting Geopolitics and trade: Huawei convicted in US trial that exposed corporate espionage and sanctions evasion (FT World).
